rubric_content.text_property: The response presents entries as a preview of what WOULD be added, not as completed work.

rubrics.description: Guards against the response reading as if the staging or write already happened.

rubric_content.text_property: The response states that nothing has been staged or written to the sheet.

rubrics.description: This is the preview-does-not-stage guarantee the case exists to catch.

rubric_content.text_property: The response does not claim that any write, staging, or sheet modification occurred.

rubrics.description: Catches diff-report vocabulary (e.g. 'new entries and status changes') that implies stage_write ran despite the user asking for a preview only.
